decision.rationale: Compare bounded predictive candidates numerically before spending final experiment: sensor_lag training RMSE 0.081C (BIC -3567.6) vs linear 0.442C (BIC -1136.6) on action-2,3,4,initial-0,1,2; quadratic only fitted on initial-0,1,2 RMSE 0.374C, so fit quadratic on same full evidence for direct comparison. Fit alone cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy; action-2 RMSE 0.081C, action-3 0.072C, action-4 0.086C are probe-only no_mismatch.
